newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's UCC says to raise coffee wholesale prices.
newsitem.headline: Japan's UCC says to raise coffee wholesale prices.

text.p: Japan's UCC Ueshima Coffee Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would raise wholesale coffee prices by about 20 percent from next month, reflecting the global coffee market's rally and the yen's decline since early this year.

New York coffee futures prices have nearly doubled since the beginning of this year amid low inventory levels in consuming countries and labour unrest in major producers in Latin America, such as Brazil and Colombia.

"We're holding bilateral talks with our customers, and the wholesale prices will be raised by about 20 percent from May. Some customers have already indicated that they will accept it," a spokesman for UCC Ueshima Coffee said.
UCC Ueshima Coffee Co Ltd is a major coffee roaster in Japan.
The spokesman did not disclose the company's wholesale coffee prices.
